newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-AmSouth upped to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-AmSouth upped to outperform.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Jacqueline Reeves confirmed she upgraded AmSouth Bancorp to outperform from a neutral rating.
-- said believes management will surprise investors with better-than-expected earnings growth over the next few years.
-- said earnings growth to be driven by cost control and more aggressive capital management.
-- raised 1997 earnings estimate to $3.95 a share from $3.85, compared to $3.50 in 1996.
-- raised 1998 earnings estimate to $4.45 a share from $4.30.
